description: Returns the stored disclosure and verification duties for a forum and a document type.

document.description: The document the duty is for, such as an affidavit or submissions.

forum.description: A forum code such as nsw-supreme-court or federal-court.

jurisdiction.description: Optional code: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT or CTH (use CTH for federal forums such as the Federal Court, FCFCOA and the Fair Work Commission). Omit it to be asked. No code is filled in for you.

name: disclosure_duties
title: Disclosure duties for a document
